guarantee.update_contract: single physical full-row set event with atomic ordered aliases
guarantee.state_bound: fixed-query local source/S/P/E/L and live-parent/child indexes; O_Q(M+K+J+U+V) affected retention plus configured spool; caller pins and allocator/arena high-water storage separate
guarantee.maintenance_bound: physical routing/support/constraints are reported separately; constraint validation may scan/copy DB; no uniform O(1) update bound
guarantee.preparation_bound: per route O_Q(1+M+K) indexed preparation; includes journal/view and productive witness discovery; no full L rebuild
guarantee.candidate_bound: fixed-query bounded candidate actions; descriptor suffix may inspect O(m^2) compiled steps; row widths and ordered costs additional
guarantee.accepted_bound: per route bounded post-preparation first/next/last successful core-result actions, including L/P/B, queues, mapping and one spool node; finalization separate
guarantee.finalization_bound: O_Q(1+M+K+J+U+V) keys/patches/undo plus unread spool and final-owner state teardown; widths/allocator/arena high-water costs additional
guarantee.public_startup_bound: complete physical epoch maintenance, all route preparation/production, SQL mapping, spool and finalization; no constant public startup
guarantee.ordered_costs: map/set operations use O(log N) comparisons in the relevant state/patch/queue; scalar widths and allocator costs are additional
guarantee.assumptions: fixed verified query/tree; running intersection; downward totality; one writer; pinned endpoint E; monotone same-sign routes
guarantee.output_accounting: one owning node per prepared record; node/value/payload quota; per-allocation allocator metadata and caller-owned records/journals are additional; unread-output and final-owner teardown are explicit cleanup
